title: The Bride of Ravenloft
summary: You gave Ireena to Strahd, and bought your lives with hers.

epilogue.title: Ireena Kolyana
epilogue.text: Ireena is wed in the castle chapel by candlelight. On clear nights she stands at a high window and looks down at a valley she will never leave.

epilogue.title: The Price Paid
epilogue.text: You are free to go anywhere in Barovia. That is the trouble with Barovia.

epilogue.title: Ismark
epilogue.text: Ismark never forgives you. He leaves a candle in his sister's window every night, in case she finds her way home.
